machine.background: Observed with a read-only process snapshot: Codex/ChatGPT, Chrome, Edge/WebView2, Notion, Claude, Steam Web Helper, PowerToys and Windows services were running. CPU load was not sampled and apps were not closed.

measurement: Sequential perf_counter wall time for pagerank only, including its setup; graph generation, sorting and JSON writing excluded. No warm-up. Each row is one repetition; compare medians for identical parameters.
prediction_before_measurement: At fixed beta/tolerance, iteration count should depend mainly on the graph's mixing, not directly on n. Wall time should grow with nodes and edges. Larger beta and tighter tolerance should usually require more iterations; finite graph structure can alter that trend.
